stations.title: Order page
stations.text: Takes any order, even zero candles.

stations.title: Customer
stations.say: It told me what was wrong.

captions: The site is in tidy files now. Next, Theo found an empty parcel: zero figs.
The order page takes any quantity and any sku, and breaks only much later.
You throw errors that say what was wrong, and catch them only where it helps.
The order for zero figs is refused, and the customer reads the reason.
Wrong orders get a clear no, and a bug in the code still stops the site.
